text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang) (Pindaan) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2014.

Pindaan tajuk

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang) 2014

[P.U. (A) 51/2014], yang disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam tajuk

dengan menggantikan perkataan "(JAMBATAN KEDUA PULAU PINANG)" dengan

perkataan "(JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH)".

Pindaan perenggan 1

3. Subperenggan 1(1) Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan perkataan

"(Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang)" dengan perkataan "(Jambatan Sultan Abdul

Halim Mu'adzam Shah)".

Pindaan perenggan 2

4. Subperenggan 2(1) Perintah ibu dipinda—

(a) dengan menggantikan perkataan "Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang"

di mana-mana jua terdapat dengan perkataan "Jambatan Sultan Abdul

Halim Mu'adzam Shah"; dan

(b) dengan menggantikan perkataan "Plaza Tol PLUS (Bandar Cassia)"

dengan perkataan "Plaza Tol Bandar Cassia".

Pindaan Jadual

5. Jadual kepada Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peta dengan peta yang

berikut:

JADUAL

"PETA JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH

Kecualian

6. Semua sebutan mengenai "Jambatan Kedua Pulau Pinang" dan "Plaza Tol PLUS

(Bandar Cassia)" dalam mana-mana undang-undang bertulis atau apa-apa surat cara,

surat ikatan, hak milik, dokumen, bon, perjanjian atau perkiraan kerja yang wujud

sebaik sebelum permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini hendaklah, pada permulaan kuat

kuasa Perintah ini, masing-masing ditafsirkan sebagai sebutan mengenai "Jambatan

Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah" dan "Plaza Tol Bandar Cassia".

SELAT SELATAN

".

Dibuat 28 Mac 2014

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/31; PN(PU2)391/XXVII]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

 [Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SECOND PENANG BRIDGE) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Pulau Pinang,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Second Penang Bridge)

(Amendment) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 April 2014.

Amendment of title

2. The Federal Roads (Second Penang Bridge) Order 2014 [P.U. (A) 51/2014], which

is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in the title by

substituting for the words "(SECOND PENANG BRIDGE)" the words "(JAMBATAN

SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH)".

Amendment of paragraph 1

3. Subparagraph 1(1) of the principal Order is amended by substituting for the words

"(Second Penang Bridge)" the words "(Jambatan Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam

Shah)".

Amendment of paragraph 2

4. Subparagraph 2(1) of the principal Order is amended—

(a) by substituting for the words "Second Penang Bridge" wherever

appearing the words "Jambatan Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "PLUS Toll Plaza (Bandar Cassia)" the words

"Bandar Cassia Toll Plaza".

Amendment of Schedule

5. The Schedule to the principal Order is amended by substituting for the map the

following map:

SCHEDULE

"MAP OF JAMBATAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM MU'ADZAM SHAH

Saving

6. All references to the "Second Penang Bridge" and "PLUS Toll Plaza (Bandar

Cassia)" in any written law or in any instrument, deed, title, document, bond, agreement

or working arrangement subsisting immediately before the commencement of this

".

SOUTH CHANNEL

Order shall, on the commencement of this Order, be construed as references to the

"Jambatan Sultan Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah" and "Bandar Cassia Toll Plaza"

respectively.

Made 28 March 2014

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/31; PN(PU2)391/XXVII]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to section 4 of the Federal Roads Act 1959]
